thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: `high_proxy_cpu` on shard proxy-eu-2 (severity: P2). link: https://pd.example.com/incidents/INC-4721
Maria: acking, I'm on it, grabbing metrics now :mag_right:
Simon: pinging dashboards — seeing a sharp spike at 12:03 UTC, looks like a 95th pct jump for ~2m then drop. not steady
OpsPager: incoming context: autoscale events show no scale-out, proxy CPU spiked while request QPS stayed flat. no 5xx spikes on frontend logs.
Maria: thanks — running `kubectl top pod proxy-eu-2 -n prod` and tailing logs, nothing shows runaway threads. starting a quick grep for slow tails
Simon: checked customer-facing latency, p50/p90 unchanged. no errors in trace sampling. probably noisy metric or collector blip.
Maria: IncidentBot shows the alert auto-resolved at 12:06 UTC (PD auto-resolve). confirming observed blip aligned with an internal prometheus scrape delay.
OpsPager: noted. still want to decide if we silence or change thresholds. it's flapping — PD paged twice in last 48h for same signal but each was <3m.
Anya: can we raise the alert aggregation window to 2m and require >2 samples? current rule is `expr: avg_over_time(proxy_cpu[1m]) > 85` which is aggressive and catches scrapes.
Simon: +1, suggest:```yaml
# suggested alert tweak
expr: avg_over_time(proxy_cpu[2m]) > 88
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: P2
```
Maria: fine with that as a quick mitigation. I'll open a task to apply to staging then prod if it looks good. creating ticket INC-4721-FLAP-TUNE
OpsPager: also recommend adding an annotation: `runbook: check-proxy-cpu` and a note to check exporter latencies.
Maria: doing the handoff — Leo, you're next on-call in 30m, fyi. I'll leave the PD rule update as pending; if it autodeploys we'll monitor for any missed legit pages.
Leo: thanks, I'll keep an eye. if we see a customer-facing regression I'll escalate immediately.
Anya: small follow-up: add a Grafana panel for exporter scrape durations in the proxy dashboard so we can correlate quickly next time.
Maria: agreed. no customer impact for this event, marking as auto-resolved transient spike. logging follow-up to runbook and dashboard card. closing thread when ticket is created. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Note: PD incident INC-4721 auto-resolved at 1829991366. escalation logs: ack by Maria at 1829991237, auto-resolve triggered by rule.
Maria: ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4721-FLAP-TUNE — assigning to Simon/Anya for follow-up. thanks all for quick checks.
Simon: quick retrospective note: consider a suppression window for identical alerts firing within 10m to reduce noise while we tune.
Maria: acknowledged. will add to postmortem notes (short). thread closed unless new info appears.
